resources.string:
Ol'Man Muz reads the runs, heart rate, speed, steps, distance, floors, calories, sleep, weight and body fat that Garmin Connect shares with Health Connect, and shows them in the app.

The data stays on this phone. The app never writes to Health Connect and never uploads your health data. It only goes online for the Home page weather forecast and, if you open an activity's route, map pictures from Thunderforest (which see the map area you view and your IP address, not the route itself).

You can remove access at any time in Health Connect.
